notes: the DATA block says it is 0x70c80 bytes, the file header's table says 0x70c88; the Wii Menu never compares the two, and only trusts the block
channel 0: the context starts at predictor/scale 0x00 but the first frame header says 0x46; the DSP starts mid-frame, so it uses the context
channel 1: the context starts at predictor/scale 0x00 but the first frame header says 0x76; the DSP starts mid-frame, so it uses the context

each loop restart decodes from the loop context instead of the running history (up to 1507 off for a few milliseconds), so the loop section is stored twice: once in the first pass, once as the repeating pass
